note: Creations and redemptions per Stock Token, from the chain: mint is a Transfer from address(0), burn is a Transfer to it. Mint minus burn is net creation, the signal an ETF publishes as net flow and that nobody publishes for these tokens. Amounts are raw tokens, 18 decimals; underlying shares are these times the multiplier in force.
method: Each run reads from the block after the last window to the current head, so windows are contiguous and disjoint. A range the node times out on is halved; one that still fails at the floor is listed in unreadRanges and the window is marked incomplete rather than published as if those logs were zero.
